title: OpenBridge Designer workflows and connector status
description: Explore OpenBridge Designer workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

OpenBridge Designer

OpenBridge Designer supports bridge modelling, analysis coordination and drawing production.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model a bridge layout

Begin with the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended OpenBridge Designer preview, model a bridge layout; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Coordinate structural analysis

Use the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended OpenBridge Designer preview, coordinate structural analysis; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare bridge documentation

Start from the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended OpenBridge Designer preview, prepare bridge documentation; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
